items.html: It follows that just as when those Mochin were within ZA, two illuminations emerged from them outward — from the aspect of the illumination of the Mochin of Aba, Yaakov emerges from the front side of ZA, and from the aspect of the illumination of the Mochin of Ima, Rachel emerges from his back side — so now too, these two illuminations certainly emerge from Rachel, the Nukva of ZA.
